test_title: PYST 32: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question: If 19 June 2001 is Tuesday, then what will be the day of the week on 14 August 2007?
solution:
An ordinary year has 1 odd day and a leap year has 2 odd days. 

So, the day on the same date for an ordinary year will be 1 day ahead and the day on the same date for a leap year will be 2 days ahead for the next year.

If 19 June 2001 is Tuesday, then the day on these dates will be:

19 June 2002 → Wednesday

19 June 2003 → Thursday
